name: Welcome Email
description: Welcome email sent to new users after registration
subject: Welcome to RISA!
content:
Hi {{recipientName}},

Welcome to RISA Notification Engine! We're excited to have you on board.

Your account has been successfully created and you can now start sending notifications.

Best regards,
The RISA Team

{{resetLink}}

If you didn't request this, please ignore this email.

Best regards,
The RISA Team
